description: US airport delays now and in history: FAA ground stops, ground delay programs, arrival/departure delays and closures, plus METAR/TAF weather and a delay-risk level per airport. No API key, no login, no proxy: official FAA and NOAA data. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/airport-delays-weather.

airports.description: US airport codes, IATA/FAA (JFK, ORD) or ICAO (KJFK, PHNL). Empty in status mode = every US airport with an active FAA delay/ground stop/closure right now plus the 10 busiest (always listed). Optional filter in delays/history/summary mode (

days.description: History and summary modes: how many days back to look (1-365). Our archive started on 2026-11-08 and grows every 5 minutes.

eventTypes.description: Optional filter for history and summary modes: ground_stop, ground_delay, arrival_departure_delay, airspace_flow, closure, deicing. Empty = all except partial closures.

forecastHours.description: How many hours of the TAF forecast to use for the outlook and the delay-risk level (1-30).

includeClosures.description: FAA also lists long-running NOTAM closures that only restrict some traffic (for example non-scheduled general aviation). Off = only full closures are shown, so airlines' normal operations are not reported as closed.

includeWeather.description: Add current METAR (flight category, wind, gusts, visibility, ceiling) and a TAF outlook (worst flight category, thunderstorms, snow, strong wind) for each airport. Live modes only.
